description:
The process starts with identifying an idea for a new product or improvement to an existing one.
The R&D team conducts initial research and feasibility studies, followed by drafting design concepts.
After selecting a promising design, a prototype is built using available materials and resources.
The prototype undergoes various tests to assess its functionality, safety, and market potential.
Feedback from the testing phase is collected, and the prototype may be refined accordingly.
If a refinement is needed, then the testing phase is reinitiated.
The process ends when the prototype is either approved for further development or discarded.
generated_bpmn_xml:
<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>
<bpmn:definitions xmlns:bpmn="http://www.omg.org/spec/BPMN/20100524/MODEL" id="Definitions_ProductDevelopment" targetNamespace="http://example.org/bpmn/product-development">
  <bpmn:process id="Process_ProductDevelopment" name="Product Idea to Prototype Decision" isExecutable="false">
    <bpmn:startEvent id="Start_IdeaIdentified" name="Idea for new or improved product identified">
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_1</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:startEvent>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_ConductResearch" name="Conduct initial research and feasibility study">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_1</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_2</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_DraftDesignConcepts" name="Draft design concepts">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_2</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_3</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_SelectDesign" name="Select promising design">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_3</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_4</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_BuildPrototype" name="Build prototype using available materials and resources">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_4</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_5</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_TestMerge" name="Merge before testing">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_5</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Refine_Return</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_6</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:exclusiveGateway>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_TestPrototype" name="Test prototype for functionality, safety and market potential">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_6</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_7</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_CollectFeedback" name="Collect feedback from testing">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_7</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_8</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_RefinementSplit" name="Refinement needed?" default="Flow_NoRefinement">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_8</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Refine</bpmn:outgoing>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_NoRefinement</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:exclusiveGateway>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_RefinePrototype" name="Refine prototype">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Refine</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Refine_Return</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_OutcomeSplit" name="Prototype outcome">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_NoRefinement</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Approved</bpmn:outgoing>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Discarded</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:exclusiveGateway>
    <bpmn:endEvent id="End_Approved" name="Prototype approved for further development">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Approved</bpmn:incoming>
    </bpmn:endEvent>
    <bpmn:endEvent id="End_Discarded" name="Prototype discarded">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Discarded</bpmn:incoming>
    </bpmn:endEvent>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_1" sourceRef="Start_IdeaIdentified" targetRef="Task_ConductResearch"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_2" sourceRef="Task_ConductResearch" targetRef="Task_DraftDesignConcepts"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_3" sourceRef="Task_DraftDesignConcepts" targetRef="Task_SelectDesign"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_4" sourceRef="Task_SelectDesign" targetRef="Task_BuildPrototype"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_5" sourceRef="Task_BuildPrototype" targetRef="Gateway_TestMerge"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_6" sourceRef="Gateway_TestMerge" targetRef="Task_TestPrototype"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_7" sourceRef="Task_TestPrototype" targetRef="Task_CollectFeedback"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_8" sourceRef="Task_CollectFeedback" targetRef="Gateway_RefinementSplit"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Refine" name="Yes" sourceRef="Gateway_RefinementSplit" targetRef="Task_RefinePrototype"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_NoRefinement" name="No" sourceRef="Gateway_RefinementSplit" targetRef="Gateway_OutcomeSplit"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Refine_Return" sourceRef="Task_RefinePrototype" targetRef="Gateway_TestMerge"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Approved" name="Approved" sourceRef="Gateway_OutcomeSplit" targetRef="End_Approved"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Discarded" name="Discarded" sourceRef="Gateway_OutcomeSplit" targetRef="End_Discarded"/>
  </bpmn:process>
</bpmn:definitions>
